meaning_en: as stated by or reported by
example_en: According to the news, it will rain tomorrow.

meaning_en: disagreeing with something or someone
example_en: Many people are against the new law.

meaning_en: to share the same idea or belief
example_en: We both agree on the plan.

meaning_en: Used to emphasize a negative statement.
example_en: I don't like coffee at all.

meaning_en: A strong feeling that something is true.
example_en: His belief in freedom is strong.

meaning_en: To think something is true or real.
example_en: I believe his story is true.

meaning_en: Really dislike something or someone.
example_en: I can't stand loud music.

meaning_en: Loyal and dedicated to a belief or person.
example_en: She is a committed member of the team.

meaning_en: Not liking change; traditional in views.
example_en: My grandparents are quite conservative.

meaning_en: A strong belief or opinion.
example_en: He spoke with deep conviction about his ideas.

meaning_en: To make someone believe something is true.
example_en: I tried to convince him to come.

meaning_en: (n) A supporter of Darwin's theory of evolution. (adj) Relating to Darwinism.
example_en: He is a strong Darwinist, believing in natural selection.

meaning_en: Working hard and giving a lot of time to something.
example_en: She is a dedicated teacher who loves her job.

meaning_en: To have a different opinion.
example_en: I disagree with your point of view.

meaning_en: To not believe something is true or likely.
example_en: I doubt he will come to the party.

meaning_en: Slightly strange or unusual in a funny way.
example_en: My uncle is eccentric; he wears a hat indoors.

meaning_en: Very great or severe; far from average.
example_en: The weather conditions were extreme.

meaning_en: Having extreme and unreasonable beliefs or enthusiasm.
example_en: He is a fanatical supporter of the football team.

meaning_en: To experience a physical sensation.
example_en: I feel cold today.

meaning_en: To have an opinion or belief.
example_en: I feel that he is right.

meaning_en: A company or business.
example_en: She works for a large law firm.

meaning_en: To have a particular opinion or belief.
example_en: I hold a different view on this matter.

meaning_en: Used to ask someone's opinion on a topic.
example_en: How do you feel about working from home?

meaning_en: Used to show you understand someone's point.
example_en: Oh, I see what you mean now.

meaning_en: A set of beliefs or ideas, especially political ones.
example_en: The party's ideology focuses on helping all people.

meaning_en: Used to express what you think.
example_en: In my opinion, that movie was excellent.

meaning_en: Relating to the mind and thinking.
example_en: She enjoys intellectual conversations.

meaning_en: Political ideas supporting equality and social change.
example_en: She has strong left-wing political views.

meaning_en: keep something in good condition.
example_en: It's important to maintain a healthy diet.

meaning_en: Not extreme; moderate or average.
example_en: His political views are quite middle-of-the-road.

meaning_en: not extreme; in the middle range
example_en: The weather was moderate, not too hot or cold.

meaning_en: relating to principles of right and wrong
example_en: It's a moral duty to help others.

meaning_en: A person who follows the religion of Islam.
example_en: Many people around the world are Muslim.

meaning_en: This is what I think or believe.
example_en: My view is that we should start early.

meaning_en: Thinking about something too much.
example_en: He is obsessive about cleanliness.

meaning_en: Strange or unusual.
example_en: That's an odd thing to say.

meaning_en: A person who believes all war and violence are wrong.
example_en: As a pacifist, he refused to join the army.

meaning_en: To some extent, but not completely.
example_en: The success was partly due to good luck.

meaning_en: Relating to a particular person, not public.
example_en: This is a personal matter.

meaning_en: Speaking for myself; in my opinion.
example_en: Personally, I think it's a good idea.

meaning_en: The study of knowledge, values, and existence.
example_en: He studies ancient Greek philosophy.

meaning_en: An idea or opinion you want to share.
example_en: What's your point about the new plan?

meaning_en: A way of thinking about something.
example_en: From my point of view, it's a good idea.

meaning_en: supporting extreme changes in politics or society
example_en: She has some radical ideas about education.

meaning_en: To think or believe something.
example_en: I reckon it will rain later today.

meaning_en: Believing in a religion; connected to religion.
example_en: She is a very religious person.

meaning_en: Supporting conservative or traditional political views.
example_en: The right-wing party won the election.

meaning_en: To show information in a written form.
example_en: The newspaper says the weather will be sunny.

meaning_en: Relating to a political system where the state owns industries.
example_en: She has socialist views on healthcare.

meaning_en: Having great power or force.
example_en: The strong wind blew down trees.

meaning_en: To believe someone is guilty of a crime.
example_en: They suspect him of stealing the money.

meaning_en: partly; not completely.
example_en: I agree with you to some extent.

meaning_en: Completely; absolutely.
example_en: I totally agree with your idea.

meaning_en: Following old customs or beliefs.
example_en: We had a traditional wedding ceremony.

meaning_en: a person who does not eat meat
example_en: My friend is a vegetarian.

meaning_en: what you can see from a place
example_en: Our hotel room has a beautiful view.

meaning_en: Very strange and unusual, sometimes a bit scary.
example_en: That was a weird dream I had last night.

meaning_en: asking for an opinion
example_en: What do you think of the new movie?
